name: browser-use
postInstallMessage: Load the matching GitHub Copilot extension, then start a new session. If the extension is not installed or enabled, use `/browser-use:doctor` for channel-appropriate installation guidance. Browser registration activates automatically at session start, and Browser guidance loads automatically when needed. Use `/browser-use:activate` to activate this installation immediately or repair setup, `/browser-use:doctor` for diagnostics, and `/browser-use:deactivate` before uninstalling or replacing this installation.
